about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The story of Alif Baa and its vision for education in Iraq
about.description: Alif Baa is an Iraqi educational platform that offers a study experience combining clear explanations, interactivity, and progress tracking. We provide video lessons following the Iraqi curriculum, questions that help students test their understanding, and educational competitions that motivate them to keep going.
about.vision: To be an educational platform trusted by Iraqi students and their families, making study an enjoyable experience that builds understanding and confidence, and gives every student the opportunity to progress and show their abilities.
about.mission: To provide clear, organized, and accessible education that helps students understand their lessons and apply what they learn, gives families a clearer picture of their level, and uses interaction and competition to encourage them to study.
about.story: The idea of Alif Baa started with a simple question: how do we make students love studying and keep going? From this question, work began on building a platform that combines clear lessons, questions that test understanding, and challenges that encourage progress. Alif Baa was founded in 2026 to offer Iraqi students a connected experience, moving from learning to application, then to competition and achievement. The name 'Alif Baa' reflects our belief that every big achievement starts with a step, and that a solid foundation opens the way to a better future.
about.difference: Alif Baa brings study elements together in one experience: video lessons following the Iraqi curriculum, interactive questions, student progress tracking, and competitions drawn from their studies. Through 'Smart Battle', what students learn becomes part of an educational challenge where they collect points and compete for ranks and weekly prizes. This way, motivation is tied to understanding and application, and every lesson plays a role in their progress.
goals: Help students understand the Iraqi curriculum and master its topics.
Organize study and make lessons and questions easily accessible.
Encourage students to review and apply continuously.
Help students discover their strengths and areas for improvement.
Support parents in tracking their children's progress.
Turn educational competition into a motivation for learning and perseverance.
about.audience: Grades from 5th Primary to 5th Preparatory following the Iraqi curriculum.
